first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion is down 4%. memory_91 directly demonstrated that activation messaging inside the product improved week-one engagement and drove first meaningful action. This is the most direct lever for the immediate activation decline. memory_86 showed that shorter onboarding improved both completion and adoption. Rather than promotional pricing (which memory_73 warns materially reduces 30-day retention despite acquisition lift), activation messaging addresses the symptom without the retention penalty. Referral incentives (memory_57) work only for established customers, not for the declining activation metric in the current funnel. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is orthogonal to the SMB/self-serve activation problem. Verifying memory_86 and memory_91 will confirm the magnitude of prior lifts and any boundary conditions. Running activation_messaging as a standard_experiment lets us test whether the prior effect holds at current baseline conditions and scales the change appropriately to the immediate problem. This preserves long-term revenue quality by avoiding retention-damaging price competition while directly targeting the growth metric in decline.

final.rationale: Verified: in-product activation messaging delivered +6% activation lift with +1% retention, and shortened onboarding delivered +13% completion with +3% retention. Both are safe, retention-positive levers. Current situation: activation down 6% QoQ, onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Activation messaging is the most direct response—it targets the immediate decline in engagement and first meaningful action without the retention penalty of promotional pricing (memory_73). The prior effect of +6% activation gain is substantial relative to current -6% decline. Onboarding simplification (memory_31, memory_86) is also viable but addresses completion rather than activation directly. Given that activation_messaging was verified to improve both engagement and activation while preserving retention, and given the primary objective is sustainable qualified revenue (not just acquisition volume), this is the highest-confidence single-week intervention. Deploy as standard_experiment to validate effect at current baseline and gather signal on interaction with the competitive pressure environment.
